title: collaborator.status.drift_detected payload
description: Payload emitted when a provider reconcile observes a state that contradicts the canonical Yggdrasil collaborator.status (e.g. Google Workspace reports suspended=true but the Yggdrasil record is still status=active). Consumed by alert-on-status-drift to fan out a Heimdall warning.

collaborator_id.description: UUID of the collaborator whose state drifts from the provider.

collaborator_slug.description: URL-safe identifier — convenient for alert payloads.

collaborator_email.description: Primary email of the collaborator — used to disambiguate in slack alerts.

yggdrasil_status.description: Canonical status stored on the collaborator row (typically 'active' at the time drift is detected).

provider.description: Provider identifier whose observed_state contradicts the canonical status (google-workspace, slack, ...).

provider_signal.description: The exact signal observed on the provider that triggered the drift detection.
